title: Fares export — ABT Fares export is exported
preface: This test is to confirm the user can export the ABT Fares export from CloudFare.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the user is signed into CloudFare
**AND** routes with a shared Service Group have fares configured (e.g. routes sharing one service group)

steps.content: **WHEN** the user runs the fares export for the ABT Fares export (XLSX or CSV)
steps.expected:
**THEN** the fares file is produced
**AND** **UNCONFIRMED** — the export surface/parameters are not confirmed; confirm live

expected:
The ABT Fares export for the selected operator is exported (XLSX or CSV).

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare]
